elements.element: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: TrueLink expressly warrants that the Hosting Services, Support Services, and other agreed-upon services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.

elements.element: Deliverables or software are warranted to conform to their documentation.
elements.evidence: The Interface and all related software are warranted to conform in all material respects to their documentation and specifications.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: The software conformance warranty runs for twelve months following the Effective Date.
The Hosting Services and Support Services are warranted for ninety days following performance.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: The stated remedies include repair or replacement of non-conforming software or services, at TrueLink's option.
The stated remedies include a refund of fees paid for the non-conforming software or services.

elements.element: Vendor warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: TrueLink warrants only compliance 'in all material respects,' permitting immaterial noncompliance rather than unqualified compliance with applicable laws.

elements.element: Vendor warrants that the Services and Deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: The malicious-code warranty covers only the Interface and related software, not the Services and all Deliverables.

elements.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The Interface and related software are warranted to conform to documentation and specifications for twelve months, exceeding ninety days.

elements.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: The Hosting Services and Support Services have a ninety-day conformance warranty following performance, exceeding thirty days.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: The stated remedies include repair or replacement of non-conforming software or services.
The stated remedies include a refund of fees paid for non-conforming software or services.
